description: This file defines the DSQLClient class for interacting with the Amazon Aurora DSQL service via AWS SDK. It includes method annotations for various cluster management operations and inherits from AwsClient.

classes.name: DSQLClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with Amazon Aurora DSQL service, extending the AwsClient base class and providing specific methods for cluster management and resource operations.

methods.name: createCluster
methods.description: Creates a new Aurora DSQL cluster.

methods.name: createClusterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new Aurora DSQL cluster.

methods.name: createMultiRegionClusters
methods.description: Creates multiple Aurora DSQL clusters across regions.

methods.name: createMultiRegionClustersAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates multiple Aurora DSQL clusters across regions.

methods.name: deleteCluster
methods.description: Deletes an existing Aurora DSQL cluster.

methods.name: deleteClusterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes an Aurora DSQL cluster.

methods.name: deleteMultiRegionClusters
methods.description: Deletes multiple Aurora DSQL clusters across regions.

methods.name: deleteMultiRegionClustersAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes multiple Aurora DSQL clusters across regions.

methods.name: getCluster
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific Aurora DSQL cluster.

methods.name: getClusterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a specific Aurora DSQL cluster.

methods.name: listClusters
methods.description: Lists all Aurora DSQL clusters.

methods.name: listClustersAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists all Aurora DSQL clusters.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Tags a resource.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously tags a resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: updateCluster
methods.description: Updates an existing Aurora DSQL cluster.

methods.name: updateClusterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates an existing Aurora DSQL cluster.
